notes: Reference-dependent amendment bill: the only operative change inserts "(including the posting of monetary bail, criminal bail bonds, and Federal immigration bail bonds)" before the comma in 18 U.S.C. 1033(f)(1)(A). The referenced statute (18 U.S.C. 1033) was NOT fetched or registered as a referencedSource, and the words "insurance", "business", "embezzlement", "charitable", "false statement", and "penalty" appear NOWHERE in the fetched source. Consequently the entire "business of insurance / insurance fraud / embezzlement / charitable bail funds" framing that dominates the analysis is UNSUPPORTED by available source (not contradicted - likely correct in reality, but unverifiable per source-only stance).
